standard.summary: 在 DiT 的 block 循环中注入计算缩减策略——跳过部分 token（TREAD）、合并相似 token（DiffCR）或跳过部分 block（BlockSkip），加速训练。
standard.effect: dit_compute_reducer_strategy='none'（默认，不缩减）。'tread' 按 token 重要性 score 保留 top-k token。'diffcr' 合并相似 token 减少序列长度。'blockskip' 跳过部分 DiT block。
standard.whenToUse: DiT 模型训练太慢时。可以接受轻微质量损失换取速度时。
standard.avoidWhen: 追求最高质量时。缩减可能导致细节丢失。

optionDescriptions.blockskip: 跳部分 DiT block，明显加速，跳多了会糊/塌。

standard_en.summary: Injects a compute-reduction strategy into the DiT's block loop -- dropping tokens (TREAD), merging similar tokens (DiffCR) or skipping blocks (BlockSkip) -- to speed training up.
standard_en.effect: dit_compute_reducer_strategy='none' (the default, no reduction). 'tread' keeps the top-k tokens by importance score. 'diffcr' merges similar tokens to shorten the sequence. 'blockskip' skips some DiT blocks.
standard_en.whenToUse: When DiT training is too slow and you can accept a slight quality loss for speed.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When quality comes first -- reduction can lose detail.

optionDescriptions.blockskip: Skips some DiT blocks: clearly faster, but skip too many and output blurs or collapses.

advanced.principle: TREAD: 对每个 token 计算重要性 score（dit_compute_reducer_score_mode='l2'），保留 top keep_ratio 比例的 token，其余跳过。dit_compute_reducer_min_keep_tokens 设置下限。DiffCR: 对 token 做聚类合并，保留 compression_ratio 比例。BlockSkip: 按 skip_ratio 跳过部分 block。dit_compute_reducer_warmup_steps 控制预热期（前 N 步不缩减）。dit_compute_reducer_min_block 控制不跳过的最低 block 索引。
advanced.intervention: DiT _run_blocks 循环中根据策略跳过 token 或 block。
advanced.expectedImpact: TREAD keep_ratio=0.7 可提速约 30%。质量损失约 2-5%。
advanced.tradeoffs: dit_compute_reducer_min_tokens 和 min_block 提供安全下限。

advanced_en.principle: TREAD: computes an importance score per token (dit_compute_reducer_score_mode='l2'), keeps the top keep_ratio fraction, skips the rest. dit_compute_reducer_min_keep_tokens sets the floor. DiffCR: cluster-merges tokens, keeping a compression_ratio fraction. BlockSkip: skips blocks by skip_ratio. dit_compute_reducer_warmup_steps controls the warmup (no reduction in the first N steps). dit_compute_reducer_min_block sets the lowest block index never skipped.
advanced_en.intervention: The DiT _run_blocks loop skips tokens or blocks per strategy.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: TREAD keep_ratio=0.7 speeds up about 30%. Quality loss roughly 2-5%.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: dit_compute_reducer_min_tokens and min_block provide safety floors.
